title: Offline full-workflow orchestration and terminal semantics

publication: review, merge, release, and remote observations
runtime: translation, dependency enforcement, and terminal projection

semantics.success: all components observed, AWQ accepted, AWG approved, UI completed, security passed, publication not performed, and remote verification unverified
semantics.failure: a bound component reports an explicit terminal failure; no later component or authority result may be invented
semantics.blocked: a required component is unavailable, undecided, incomplete, or dependency-gated; partial state is never success
semantics.replay: exact operation ID and canonical payload are idempotent; changed or reordered replay is rejected

failure_semantics.side_effects: No provider, network, LLM, process, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, UI, Git, publication, or durable-state operation is performed.

limitations: The harness validates supplied observations only.
A terminal projection is not a live Coordinator transition, provider result, hosted-CI result, publication, or authority decision.
